title: Alphonic
identity: Bernard Wystraete's *Alphonic* is for alto saxophone and piano, Leduc AL27127. The Philharmonie guide describes two sections, gives an opening Allegretto at quarter note 92, and notes a return to the opening theme after a quicker contrasting section. It reports a low-E to high-C range; the pitch convention needs confirmation in the part. The guide says 'en ut pour le saxophone'; its pitch convention should be checked before applying the range to a transposed part.

evidence.claim: Guide describes a two-section form, opening Allegretto in 4/4 at quarter note 92, faster contrasting section and return, dynamic/articulation contrasts, easy rhythms, and low E to high C range.
evidence.source_name: Philharmonie de Paris, *10 ans avec le saxophone*

evidence.claim: Publisher catalog listing and number appears in the guide as Leduc AL27127.

review_focus: Inference from the guide: verify the faster middle section and return, dynamic contrast, and articulation patterns in the part.
collection_flag: Repertoire guide gives concrete educational-use information; no evidence of a lyrical non-saxophone transcription.
gaps: No score pages or matching recording inspected; verify the range against the edition and confirm the guide's pitch convention.
